description: Pinned-source audit. Assumed economics, descriptive historical growth and simulated reactions are not measured predictive edge.

goldTrend.detail: Descriptive CAGR of nominal annual gold means from 2020 to 2025. Partial years are excluded. Historical publication dates are unverified. Applying this growth to a hypothetical option is an assumption, not a forecast.

coverage.label: Sample-to-land records
coverage.detail: 33 of 33 area A samples matched to the checked-layer snapshot, including explicit no-match rows. Counts are unique samples, not record pairs.

coverage.label: Mineral title and available interest
coverage.detail: State records and recorded holders do not establish conveyable mineral rights, an available option, assignment consent or liability release. Federal and Native corporation status remain unchecked.

coverage.label: Five-year gold baseline
coverage.detail: Descriptive CAGR of nominal annual gold means from 2020 to 2025. Partial years are excluded. Historical publication dates are unverified. Applying this growth to a hypothetical option is an assumption, not a forecast.

coverage.label: Current commodity quote
coverage.detail: Annual means and the partial 2026 mean are not an executable current gold quote.

coverage.label: Tok mineral-land price baseline
coverage.detail: 10 heterogeneous Alaska deals and statewide surface-sale summaries provide context. Surface medians are not a Tok mineral-price index or a guaranteed value floor.

coverage.label: Holding-cost context
coverage.detail: A dated state-rent schedule is supplied. Current legal applicability, claim age, labour obligations and which party pays remain unverified; no costs are assigned to the option model.

coverage.label: Recoverable resource and success probability
coverage.detail: Sediment assays and land overlaps do not supply recoverable ounces, a geological success probability or a conversion factor.

coverage.label: Available option and executable terms
coverage.detail: No verified available Tok assignment quote, premium, buyer exercise consideration, expiry or capped obligation schedule is supplied.

coverage.label: Assignment liquidity
coverage.detail: Claim counts, surface auctions and mixed project deals do not calibrate a 30/90/180-day option-assignment sale probability.

coverage.label: Point-in-time evaluation data
coverage.detail: Snapshot and retrieval dates are recorded separately. Historical publication times and realized assignment outcomes are not supplied.

coverage.label: Scenario run inputs
coverage.detail: 9/9 configurations supplied. Configurations are not completed simulations.

coverage.label: One-day pilot output
coverage.detail: One-day timing and format pilot only. It has no day-3 intervention or days 3–5 observations.

coverage.label: Completed scored scenario runs
coverage.detail: No final report exists in the pinned branch tree; the day-1 pilot cannot supply day-3 scenario effects.

coverage.label: Scenario source knowledge cutoff
coverage.detail: Input information availability must be supplied separately from generation, commit and retrieval times.

coverage.label: Measured predictive edge
coverage.detail: No dated Tok option outcomes establish out-of-sample price skill, sale-probability calibration or net trading returns.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Human check of scoring judge
swarmDiagnostics.detail: 27/30 pilot scores within 2 points; threshold 24/30. This does not validate market prediction.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Three-baseline spread available
swarmDiagnostics.detail: Complete days 3–5 group means from baseline seeds 1, 2 and 3 are required.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Placebo remains inside baseline bands
swarmDiagnostics.detail: The placebo and three scored baselines are required.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Baseline interview-call stability
swarmDiagnostics.detail: Upstream check requires at least two of three baseline majority calls to agree.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Interview evidence grounding
swarmDiagnostics.detail: Requires the upstream sampled-answer grounding check; no market outcome is tested.

swarmDiagnostics.label: mine approval expected response
swarmDiagnostics.detail: At least one pre-registered group must move in the expected direction beyond both its chance band and the placebo effect.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Approval and court-block mirror
swarmDiagnostics.detail: Fund responses must oppose each other and each exceed the baseline band.

swarmDiagnostics.label: proposed tax expected response
swarmDiagnostics.detail: At least one pre-registered group must move in the expected direction beyond both its chance band and the placebo effect.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Approval and court-block mirror

swarmDiagnostics.label: gold reversal expected response
swarmDiagnostics.detail: At least one pre-registered group must move in the expected direction beyond both its chance band and the placebo effect.

swarmDiagnostics.label: Gold-reversal mirror
swarmDiagnostics.detail: Fund and retail support must both fall beyond their baseline bands.
